description: Human-maintained, by commit: the model id(s) each provider profile in city.toml is currently allowed to run. bin/provider-failover check-models compares this daily against the id actually configured in city.toml and surfaces drift (a bead plus mail to the Mayor) -- it never edits a model id itself, per ADR-0018's 'switch models only via provider-failover set' invariant. Update this file by commit when a provider ships a new recommended model or deprecates one.
